model_annotation: The plot illustrates a comparison of several lines with respect to a co-occurrence number. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" and uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 1000, with tick labels at 1, 10, 100, and 1000. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" and uses a linear scale, ranging from 40 to 65. A blue solid line, labeled "FT," starts at approximately 38% at co-occurrence number 1 and increases steadily to approximately 51% at co-occurrence number 1000. A red dashed line, labeled "IKE," begins at approximately 46% at co-occurrence number 1 and gradually increases to approximately 49% at co-occurrence number 1000. A magenta solid line, labeled "MEMEMIT," starts at roughly 50% at co-occurrence number 1 and goes up to around 55% at co-occurrence number 1000. A gray solid line, labeled "Base," begins at approximately 44% at co-occurrence number 1 and increases to about 50% at co-occurrence number 1000. A purple dashed line, labeled "MEND," starts at approximately 49% at co-occurrence number 1 and increases to around 53% at co-occurrence number 1000. Finally, a green triangular marker line, labeled "ROME," commences at about 50% at co-occurrence number 1 and increases to about 63% at co-occurrence number 1000.
